opening.argument: The presentation primarily discusses Stellar XLM as an investment topic, pairing market-chart imagery with concrete strategies such as dollar-cost averaging and diversification. Its wealth-creation language is expressly qualified: the narration says that potential returns are not guaranteed, and the description warns that the market can be highly volatile. Those qualifications matter when assessing the separate MEXC signup-bonus instruction. It is a promotional element, but the supplied material does not establish deceptive conduct or connect that instruction to a scam mechanism. Taken as a whole, the presentation supports an educational and market-analysis reading rather than a claim of assured financial gains.
